overall.headline: Community barriers detected
overall.sentence: Barriers in community diversity and transportation access.

indicators.label: Unemployment rate
indicators.definition: Share of the labour force that is unemployed.

indicators.label: High housing cost
indicators.definition: Households spending over 30% of income on housing.

indicators.label: Lone-parent families
indicators.definition: Families led by a single parent.

indicators.label: Separated, divorced, or widowed
indicators.definition: Adults who are separated, divorced, or widowed.

indicators.label: Recent immigrants
indicators.definition: Residents who immigrated in the last 5 years.

indicators.label: Non-official language at home
indicators.definition: Households speaking a non-official language at home.

indicators.label: Moved within the last year
indicators.definition: Residents who moved in the past year.

indicators.label: Active Living index
indicators.definition: Walkability / active-living environment score (1 low – 5 high).

indicators.label: Air — PM2.5
indicators.definition: Average fine particulate matter (µg/m³). Lower is cleaner.

indicators.label: Air — NO₂
indicators.definition: Average nitrogen dioxide. Lower is cleaner.

indicators.label: Water — arsenic
indicators.definition: Private wells exceeding the arsenic limit.

indicators.label: Water — uranium
indicators.definition: Private wells exceeding the uranium limit.
